userdoc.notice: Stateless lifecycle hook admitting any orchestrator registered in OrchestratorRegistry and enforcing maker-owned whitelist policies. A taker is admitted when enforcement is disabled or when the policy allows the taker directly or through an allowed group. Settlement and cancellation are no-ops in this version.
